# Run book: Send a webhook to a channel

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/send-a-webhook.md) | [Spec](../specs/send-a-webhook.md)

## Purpose

See how the host answers a provider call: 204 when processed, 400 for a bad signature, 404 for an unknown channel.

## Preconditions

- The example API is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Send a webhook to a channel"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/messaging/webhooks`:

1. **Send the call.** The channel and a sample body are filled in. The response status and problem details are shown. Expect: A response status is shown. The problem details name the rejection.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 404 Webhook rejected | The channel is not in OoBDev:Communications:Channels | Use a configured channel name |
| 400 Webhook rejected | The vendor signature is missing or wrong | Send the call from the provider, or sign it as the vendor does |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Communications (`IReceiveService`).
